analytic_diagnostic_dictionary.elementary_formal_computation: For fixed x in [a,1/3), integrate 1/[y*(1-x-y)] to (log y-log(1-x-y))/(1-x). At y=(1-x)/2 the numerator is0, and at y=1/3 it is -log(2-3x). Thus the anticipated one-dimensional formula is integral_a^(1/3) log(2-3x)/(x*(1-x)) dx. This calculation has not been added as a Lean Fubini/FTC dictionary for U8.
